黑龍Black Dragon

    作爲色彩龍中最暴躁卑劣的種類，黑龍會將倒斃者的殘骸連同其財寶一同收集起來。黑龍們厭惡眼見弱者的興盛，並樂見類人生物王國崩潰。惡臭的沼澤，以及覆亡王國曾經聳立的廢墟瓦礫會是它們理想的家園。
    深陷的眼窩和顯眼的開放性鼻孔使得黑龍看起來酷似骷髏。它那彎曲、分節的雙角在根部附近爲骨白色的，而越靠近末端就越變暗爲死黑色。隨着黑龍年齡的增長，它雙角和顴骨周圍的皮肉就像是被強酸侵蝕了一樣，退化直至只剩下薄薄的一層皮膚，並因此更特顯其骷髏一般的外貌。黑龍頭上帶有標誌性的尖刺和犄角。它扁平的舌頭在末端分叉，強酸味的粘稠流涎增強了黑龍身上那混雜着腐爛植被與污水的惡臭。
    在剛孵化時，黑龍擁有烏黑髮亮的鱗片。隨着年齡的增長，它的鱗片會變得厚實而暗淡，以讓其融入到家園的沼澤和崩塌廢墟之中。

    野蠻而殘忍Brutal and Cruel。所有的色彩龍都是邪惡，而黑龍更因其殘虐的本性而顯得格外突出。觀賞獵物求饒即是黑龍的生活樂趣，而它們也時常爲敵人制造可以喘息或逃跑的假象。
    黑龍會優先攻擊最弱的敵人，以確保能迅速而殘暴的獲勝，並以此令剩下的敵人感到恐懼和滿足其自負心理。在快要戰敗時，黑龍會做不擇手段的保全自己。而且在它認命受死之前，黑龍決不允許任何人凌駕其上。

    敵人與奴僕Foes and Servants。黑龍憎恨並恐懼其他龍族，它們從遠處窺探作爲對手的龍類，以此伺機殺死較弱者並回避與強者遭遇。如果一頭更強的龍對其造成威脅，黑龍會放棄其巢穴而前去尋找新的領地。
    邪惡的蜥蜴人lizardfolk崇拜並臣服於黑龍。它們會洗劫類人生物定居點，並將得來的財寶和食物用作貢品。它們還會製作粗糙的龍形塑像，並安置於其黑龍主子領地的周邊區域。
    黑龍本身的惡意還會影響周圍扎堆而來的邪惡原始生物，使它們主動尋找並殺戮出現在黑龍巢穴的善良生物。
    許多黑龍巢穴內會像蟲子一樣滋生着狗頭人。這些羣體受其黑暗主人影響而越來越殘忍，時常在將俘虜們帶去給黑龍填肚子前，用蜈蚣叮咬和蠍子蜇刺對其施行折磨削弱。

    遠古的財富Wealth of the Ancients。黑龍囤積來自崩潰帝國和被征服王國的寶藏和魔法物品，並以此彰顯自己的偉大。黑龍活過的時間經歷過越多的文明，其對當前文明意欲索取的財富名目就越是繁多。

黑龍巢穴A Black Dragon’s Lair

    黑龍居住在文明地區邊緣，那些經常發生摩擦的沼澤中。黑龍的巢穴是一處陰暗的洞穴，石窟或者至少是被部分淹沒的廢墟，其內通常設有供黑龍休息的水池，而受害者的殘骸也會在其中發酵。龍穴中到處都是死去受害者被強酸侵蝕的骸骨，蒼蠅縈繞的新鮮死屍，以及守望在其內的殘損塑像。巢穴四處出沒着蜈蚣、蠍子和蛇，還散發着死亡與腐朽的惡臭。
色彩龍Chromatic Dragons

    

黑龍、藍龍、綠龍、紅龍和白龍代表着龍類邪惡方勢力。好鬥、貪婪、自負的色彩龍是黑暗賢者或強大暴君，以恐懼壓迫衆生——包括它們的同類。

    貪婪爲動力Driven by Greed。色彩龍迷戀財寶，這種貪婪本質會貫徹它們的每項計劃和陰謀中。它們認爲自己有權佔有世界上所有的財富，因此色彩龍抓獲這些被類人或其他生物“偷”走的財寶時無需半點遲疑。這些成堆的錢幣、耀眼的寶石和魔法裝備，即是傳說中的巨龍寶庫。此外，色彩龍對商務活動毫無興趣，其積累財富單純是爲了擁有而並非爲了其他。

    自負的生物Creatures of Ego。色彩龍們一致承認自身族類的優越性，相信自己是凡間生物中的至高志強者。與其他生物互動時，它們也只關注自身利益的得失。色彩龍們堅信自己具有與生俱來的統治權，而這種信念正是其世界觀的基石。讓色彩龍謙虛就如同說服風停止吹動。在它們看來，類人生物只是動物，只適合作爲獵物和馱獸且完全不值得尊重。

    危險的巢穴Dangerous Lairs。龍的巢穴相當去其權利的寶座，也是其儲存財寶的寶庫。雖然龍類可以憑着其天生的耐性與韌性承受各種惡劣環境效應，但它們還是築起巢穴以作防守而非安居。此外，這些巢穴都會設置多個出入口，其內還爲其寶庫設置了安保措施。
    色彩龍的巢穴大多建在危險的偏遠地區，以防止那些最大膽的凡人前來拜訪。黑龍會將巢穴建在一片廣闊沼澤中央，而紅龍則可能佔據活火山的噴發口作其巢穴。除依靠大自然防禦巢穴外，一些強大的色彩龍還會使用魔法守衛、陷阱和其他順從的生物作爲巢穴的護衛。

    惡龍女王Queen of Evil Dragons。龍後提亞馬特Tiamat the Dragon Queen是邪惡龍 類的主神。她定居於九層地獄的第一層阿佛納斯Avernus中。作爲一名弱等神力，提亞馬特可以授予其崇拜者法術，只是她並不喜歡分享自己的力量。她是所有惡龍貪婪的集合體，自認爲多元宇宙和其中所有的寶藏終有一天都將成爲她獨享的所有物。
    提亞馬特是一頭體型龐大的巨龍。它的五顆頭顱反映了崇拜她的色彩龍——黑龍、藍龍、綠龍、紅龍和白龍。她的五種吐息武器可以消滅一整支軍隊，加上其可怕的施法能力以及駭人的龍爪使其成爲戰場上的恐懼之源。
    提亞馬特最痛恨的敵人，鉑金龍巴哈姆特Bahamut the Platinum Dragon，同時也是與她分享所有龍類信仰的存在。另外，她也保留着對阿斯蒙蒂斯Asmodeus的特殊恨意——後者在很久之前，爲了限制龍後的力量而剝奪了她對阿佛納斯的統治權。
龍Dragons

    真龍是擁有古老血統和驚人力量的有翼爬行類。它們以狡詐貪婪的掠奪者形象而威名遠揚，而最古老的龍也可以作爲其所在世界最強大的生物。龍類還包含了其他一些天生具有強大力量，可以使用恐怖吐息武器或其它超自然能力的魔法生物。
    許多生物（包括飛龍wyverns和龍龜dragon turtles）都擁有龍族血統。而真龍則只包括金屬龍和色彩龍兩大類別。黑龍、藍龍、綠龍、紅龍和白龍全都自私邪惡，而又令人恐懼。黃銅龍、青銅龍、赤銅龍、金龍和銀龍則體現着高貴與善良，而且睿智又令人敬畏。
    儘管它們的目標和理想千差萬別，但所有的真龍都貪戀財富，會收集成堆的錢幣並收集寶石、首飾和魔法道具。囤積了大量財寶的龍不大部分時間都呆在其寶庫中，而只有在巡視和覓食時纔會走出其巢穴。
    真龍的整個生命週期貫穿其四個不同的年齡階段，一條龍從弱小的雛龍到遠古龍可以存活長達一千年。在此期間，它們的實力將逐漸變得無可匹敵，而其財富也會超值增長。

定製龍類Customizing Dragons FTD p33

正如《地下城主指南》中所說，你可以定製任何龍的數據以反映龍的獨特能力。像下面這樣的小改動是很容易做到的，而且對龍的挑戰等級沒有影響。

語言Laanguages。大多數龍喜歡說龍語，但爲了與盟友和僕從打交道同樣也需要學習通用語。鑑於龍的高智力和長壽命，它們可以很容易地學習其他語言。你可以將一些額外語言添加到龍的資料卡中。

技能Skills。大多數龍都具有察覺和隱匿技能的熟練項，許多龍還有額外的技能熟練。和語言一樣，你可以定製龍的技能列表（甚至將他們對某些技能的熟練翻倍）以反映其特殊的興趣和技巧。你也可以給龍提供工具熟練，特別是當龍在人形狀態下花費了一段時間訓練時。

法術Spells。《怪物圖鑑》中關於讓龍成爲天生的施法者的變體規則是一種簡單的方法，可以在不影響龍的挑戰等級的情況下爲其增加多樣性。第5章爲不同種類的龍提供了建議的法術列表，但你也可以選擇法術來反映龍的特性。一條天生施展德魯伊法術的龍與施展術士法術的龍給人的感覺會截然不同。你也可以給龍提供比這個變體規則所允許的更高等級的法術，但這樣的調整可能會增加龍的挑戰等級——尤其是當這些法術能直接對目標造成傷害或施加各類增益/減益時。

其他特質和動作Other Traits and Actions。你可以借用其他怪物的特性和行動來爲龍增加獨特的風味。考慮一下這些例子。

變形Change Shape。你可以決定讓龍在比平時更小的年齡獲得這個動作，特別是想在你的戰役中靠類人形態來塑造龍類時。本章後面的 "變形 "部分提供了更多信息和靈感。(參見《怪物圖鑑》中的金屬龍Metallic Dragons）。)

傷害吸收Damage Absorption。你也許會令紅龍或金龍不僅不受火焰傷害，甚至還能被烈焰治癒。(參見《怪物圖鑑》中的肉身魔像Flesh Golem）。)

飛掠Flyby。龍那超凡的飛行技巧使其能迅速飛出敵人的威脅範圍。(參見《怪物圖鑑》中的鹿鷹獸peryton）。)

擬聲Mimicry。對狡猾的龍來說，模仿冒險者或他們的盟友可能是一個有趣並且的確有用的技巧。(參見《怪物圖鑑》中的天狗Kenku）。)

復生Rejuvenation。在你的戰役中，你可能會將作爲物質位面重要組分的龍類設定爲幾乎不可能被完全殺死的存在。就像巫妖的靈魂被保存在命匣裏一樣，龍的生命精華可能會被保存在它最初出現的蛋裏、它的寶庫裏，或者世界中心的一個巨大洞穴裏。(參見《怪物圖鑑》中的巫妖Lich。)

特殊感官Special Sense。大多數龍都有盲視和黑暗視覺。你可以將黑暗視覺升級爲真實視覺，或者你可以給一條有掘地速度的龍賦予顫動感知。(見《怪物圖鑑》的相關介紹）。)

掘道者Tunneler。任何具有掘地速度的龍都可以具有這種特性，即，在堅硬的岩石中移動，並在其後面挖出一條隧道。(參見《怪物圖鑑》中的土巨怪umber hulk）。)

變體：龍類天生施法者Variant: Dragons as Innate Spellcasters[–]

青年黑龍天生可以施展法術，且不需任何材料成分。而該法術的環階也不能超過2階。 該龍的法術豁免DC等於 13，該龍的法術攻擊加值+5。

《怪物圖鑑》中關於讓龍成爲天生的施法者的變體規則是一種簡單的方法，可以在不影響龍的挑戰等級的情況下爲其增加多樣性。第5章爲不同種類的龍提供了建議的法術列表，但你也可以選擇法術來反映龍的特性。一條天生施展德魯伊法術的龍與施展術士法術的龍給人的感覺會截然不同。你也可以給龍提供比這個變體規則所允許的更高等級的法術，但這樣的調整可能會增加龍的挑戰等級——尤其是當這些法術能直接對目標造成傷害或施加各類增益/減益時。示例如下：

  • 目盲／耳聾術 blindness/deafness
  • 造水/枯水術 create or destroy water

Source: FTD

變體：龍類天生施法者Variant: Dragons as Innate Spellcasters

    龍作爲天生的魔法生物，其隨着年齡的增長可能會逐漸掌握一些法術，此時便可以使用該變體。
    一條青年龍或更年長的龍天生可以施展的法術數量等同於其魅力調整值。每個法術每日只能施展一次，且不需任何材料成分，而該法術的環階也不能超過這條龍挑戰等級的三分之一（向下取整）。該龍的法術攻擊加值等於其熟練加值＋其魅力調整值。該龍的法術豁免DC等於8＋其熟練加值＋其魅力調整值。

這條青年黑龍天生可以施展法術，且不需任何材料成分。而該法術的環階也不能超過2階。 該龍的法術豁免DC等於 13，該龍的法術攻擊加值+5。請參閱“法術”頁面，以獲取該龍能夠獲得的法術。示例如下：

  • 黑暗術 darkness
  • 馬友夫強酸箭 Melf's acid arrow
  • 雲霧術 fog cloud
  • 灼熱射線 scorching ray


The most evil-tempered and vile of the chromatic dragons, black dragons collect the wreckage and treasures of fallen peoples. These dragons loathe seeing the weak prosper and revel in the collapse of humanoid kingdoms. They make their homes in fetid swamps and crumbling ruins where kingdoms once stood.

With deep-socketed eyes and broad nasal openings, a black dragon's face resembles a skull. Its curving, segmented horns are bone-colored near the base and darken to dead black at the tips. As a black dragon ages, the flesh around its horns and cheekbones deteriorates as though eaten by acid, leaving thin layers of hide that enhance its skeletal appearance. A black dragon's head is marked by spikes and horns. Its tongue is flat with a forked tip, drooling slime whose acidic scent adds to the dragon's reek of rotting vegetation and foul water.

When it hatches, a black dragon has glossy black scale. As it ages, its scales become thicker and duller, helping it blend in to the marshes and blasted ruins that are its home.

Brutal and Cruel. All chromatic dragons are evil, but black dragons stand apart for their sadistic nature. A black dragon lives to watch its prey beg for mercy, and will often offer the illusion of respite or escape before finishing off its enemies.

A black dragon strikes at its weakest enemies first, ensuring a quick and brutal victory, which bolsters its ego as it terrifies its remaining foes. On the verge of defeat, a black dragon does anything it can to save itself, but it accepts death before allowing any other creature to claim mastery over it.

Foes and Servants. Black dragons hate and fear other dragons. They spy on draconic rivals from afar, looking for opportunities to slay weaker dragons and avoid stronger ones. If a stronger dragon threatens it, a black dragon abandons its lair and seeks out new territory.

Evil lizardfolk venerate and serve black dragons, raiding humanoid settlements for treasure and food to give as tribute and building crude draconic effigies along the borders of their dragon master's domain.

A black dragon's malevolent influence might also cause the spontaneous creation of evil shambling mounds that seek out and slay good creatures approaching the dragon's lair.

Kobolds infest the lairs of many black dragons like vermin. They become as cruel as their dark masters, often torturing and weakening captives with centipede bites and scorpion stings before delivering them to sate the dragon's hunger.

Wealth of the Ancients. Black dragons hoard the treasures and magic items of crumbled empires and conquered kingdoms to remind themselves of their greatness. The more civilizations a dragon outlasts, the more entitled it feels to claim the wealth of current civilizations for itself.

A Black Dragon's Lair

Black dragons dwell in swamps on the frayed edges of civilization. A black dragon's lair is a dismal cave, grotto, or ruin that is at least partially flooded, providing pools where the dragon rests, and where its victims can ferment. The lair is littered with the acid-pitted bones of previous victims and the fly-ridden carcasses of fresh kills, watched over by crumbling statues. Centipedes, scorpions, and snakes infest the lair, which is filled with the stench of death and decay.

Chromatic Dragons

The black, blue, green, red, and white dragons represent the evil side of dragonkind. Aggressive, gluttonous, and vain, chromatic dragons are dark sages and powerful tyrants feared by all creatures-including each other.

Driven by Greed. Chromatic dragons lust after treasure, and this greed colors their every scheme and plot. They believe that the world's wealth belongs to them by right, and a chromatic dragon seizes that wealth without regard for the humanoids and other creatures that have "stolen" it. With its piles of coins, gleaming gems, and magic items, a dragon's hoard is the stuff of legend. However, chromatic dragons have no interest in commerce, amassing wealth for no other reason than to have it.

Creatures of Ego. Chromatic dragons are united by their sense of superiority, believing themselves the most powerful and worthy of all mortal creatures. When they interact with other creatures, it is only to further their own interests. They believe in their innate right to rule, and this belief is the cornerstone of every chromatic dragon's personality and worldview. Trying to humble a chromatic dragon is like trying to convince the wind to stop blowing. To these creatures, humanoids are animals, fit to serve as prey or beasts of burden, and wholly unworthy of respect.

Dangerous Lairs. A dragon's lair serves as the seat of its power and a vault for its treasure. With its innate toughness and tolerance for severe environmental effects, a dragon selects or builds a lair not for shelter but for defense, favoring multiple entrances and exits, and security for its hoard.

Most chromatic dragon lairs are hidden in dangerous and remote locations to prevent all but the most audacious mortals from reaching them. A black dragon might lair in the heart of a vast swamp, while a red dragon might claim the caldera of an active volcano. In addition to the natural defenses of their lairs, powerful chromatic dragons use magical guardians, traps, and subservient creatures to protect their treasures.

Queen of Evil Dragons. Tiamat the Dragon Queen is the chief deity of evil dragonkind. She dwells on Avernus, the first layer of the Nine Hells. As a lesser god, Tiamat has the power to grant spells to her worshipers, though she is loath to share her power. She epitomizes the avarice of evil dragons, believing that the multiverse and all its treasures will one day be hers and hers alone.

Tiamat is a gigantic dragon whose five heads reflect the forms of the chromatic dragons that worship her-black, blue, green, red, and white. She is a terror on the battlefield, capable of annihilating whole armies with her five breath weapons, her formidable spellcasting, and her fearsome claws.

Tiamat's most hated enemy is Bahamut the Platinum Dragon, with whom she shares control of the faith of dragonkind. She also holds a special enmity for Asmodeus, who long ago stripped her of the rule of Avernus and who continues to curb the Dragon Queen's power.

Dragons

True dragons are winged reptiles of ancient lineage and fearsome power. They are known and feared for their predatory cunning and greed, with the oldest dragons accounted as some of the most powerful creatures in the world. Dragons are also magical creatures whose innate power fuels their dreaded breath weapons and other preternatural abilities.

Many creatures, including wyverns and dragon turtles, have draconic blood. However, true dragons fall into the two broad categories of chromatic and metallic dragons. The black, blue, green, red, and white dragons are selfish, evil, and feared by all. The brass, bronze, copper, gold, and silver dragons are noble, good, and highly respected by the wise.

Though their goals and ideals vary tremendously, all true dragons covet wealth, hoarding mounds of coins and gathering gems, jewels, and magic items. Dragons with large hoards are loath to leave them for long, venturing out of their lairs only to patrol or feed.

True dragons pass through four distinct stages of life, from lowly wyrmlings to ancient dragons, which can live for over a thousand years. In that time, their might can become unrivaled and their hoards can grow beyond price.

Customizing Dragons FTD p33[–]

You can customize any dragon's stat block to reflect the dragon's unique character. Minor changes such as those below are easy to make and have no impact on a dragon's challenge rating.

Languages. Most dragons prefer to speak Draconic but learn Common for dealing with allies and minions. But given their high Intelligence and long life span, dragons can easily learn additional languages. You can add languages to a dragon's stat block.

Skills. Most dragons are proficient in the Perception and Stealth skills, and many dragons have additional skill proficiencies. As with languages, you can customize a dragon's skill list (even doubling their proficiency bonus with certain skills) to reflect particular interests and activities. You can also give a dragon tool proficiencies, particularly if the dragon spends time in Humanoid form.

Spells. See the "Variant: Dragons as Innate Spellcasters" inset(s), below.

Other Traits and Actions. You can borrow traits and actions from other monsters to add unique flavor to a dragon. Consider these examples:

  • Flyby. The dragon is an agile flier, quick to fly out of enemies' reach.The dragon doesn't provoke an opportunity attack when it flies out of an enemy's reach.

  • Mimicry. Impersonating characters or their allies could be a fun trick for a crafty dragon.The dragon can mimic any sounds it has heard, including voices. A creature that hears the sounds can tell they are imitations with a successful DC 10 Wisdom (Insight) check.

  • Rejuvenation. You might decide that dragons in your campaign, being an essential part of the Material Plane, are nearly impossible to destroy. A dragon's life essence might be preserved in the egg from which it first emerged, in its hoard, or in a cavernous hall at the center of the world, just as a lich's essence is hidden in a phylactery.If it has an essence-preserving object, a destroyed dragon gains a new body in 1d10 days, regaining all its hit points and becoming active again. The new body appears within 5 feet of the object.

  • Special Senses. Most dragons have blindsight and darkvision. You might upgrade blindsight to truesight, or you could give a dragon with a burrowing speed tremorsense.

Variant: Dragons as Innate Spellcasters[–]

This dragon can innately cast two spells, once per day each, requiring no material components. Each spell's level can be no higher than 2nd. The dragon's spell save DC is DC 13, and it has +5 to hit with spell attacks.

A suggested spell list is shown below, but you can also choose spells to reflect the dragon's character. A dragon who innately casts druid spells feels different from one who casts warlock spells. You can also give a dragon spells of a higher level than this rule allows, but such a tweak might increase the dragon's challenge rating—especially if those spells deal damage or impose conditions on targets.

  • blindness/deafness
  • create or destroy water

Source: FTD

Variant: Dragons as Innate Spellcasters[–]

Dragons are innately magical creatures that can master a few spells as they age, using this variant.

A young or older dragon can innately cast a number of spells equal to its Charisma modifier. Each spell can be cast once per day, requiring no material components, and the spell's level can be no higher than one-third the dragon's challenge rating (rounded down). The dragon's bonus to hit with spell attacks is equal to its proficiency bonus + its Charisma bonus. The dragon's spell save DC equals 8 + its proficiency bonus + its Charisma modifier.

This dragon can innately cast two spells, once per day each, requiring no material components. Each spell's level can be no higher than 2nd. The dragon's spell save DC is DC 13, and it has +5 to hit with spell attacks. See the spell page for a list of spells the dragon is capable of casting. A selection of examples are shown below:

  • darkness
  • Melf's acid arrow
  • fog cloud
  • scorching ray
